jobs.title: Business Development Director
jobs.description:
About Discovery Life Sciences:

Discovery Life Sciences (Discovery) is a leading provider of highly characterized human biospecimens and cellular starting materials to advance cell and gene therapy and precision medicine programs for cancer, infectious disease, and other complex conditions. We routinely manage hundreds of studies and expertly test thousands of biospecimens simultaneously. Leading biopharma, diagnostic and academic institutions trust us to quickly deliver high-quality biospecimens and reliable, reproducible biomarker data, so they can outpace their competition and push the leading edge of innovation using our Science at your Service TM business model.

Position Summary:

Discovery is looking for a talented and passionate Business Development Director to join our dynamic biospecimen products sales team. As a Business Development Director, you will be an individual contributor, responsible for growing top line revenue and increasing market share by supporting the use of our products in the fields of BioPharma Discovery, Translational, and Clinical Research. This will be accomplished by comprehensive planning and executing sales strategies in your assigned territory. We offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where you can unleash your creativity and make a real impact.

A Day in the Life of a Business Development Director at Discovery Life Sciences:

Prospect and source potential biopharma customers
Meet with potential customers to understand their scientific research and where our company can add value to their research.
Attend networking events.
Collaborate with scientific SMEs to obtain sales contracts.
Build and update business development strategy for current territory.

Position Qualifications (Education, Skills, Experience):

BSc, MSc, or PhD in a life science preferred
Minimum of five (5) years of field-based sales experience in Life Sciences, CDMO, or Biotech to biopharma customers.
Experience in human biospecimens OR cell and gene therapy sales required.
Proven track record of achieving 100% of quota.
Ability to work with clients, actively listen to needs, and translate into opportunities.
Ability to build and nurture relationships with clients and potential clients.
Team-first attitude and passion to achieve Commercial Team and company-wide goals.
Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
Excellent computer skills to include Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Google Docs.
SalesForce.com experience is desirable but not required.
Must be located in the greater Boston, MA area.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop, propose, and implement monthly, quarterly and annual territory plans to meet revenue goals and achieve quota attainment.
Generate new business through a high level of customer and prospect contact including frequent direct customer visits and extensive networking.
Actively manage a pipeline of 100 opportunities, keeping information up to date, and logging call notes from field activity
Communicate clearly to executive stakeholders including operations, marketing, SMEs, and project management teams, to ensure that prospects are provided with well-orchestrated and timely information to ensure successful closure of opportunities.
Work closely and collaboratively with assigned Project Manager towards attainment of territory goal and 100% customer success
Develop and maintain deep product knowledge to sell consultatively and make recommendations to prospective clients on solutions that best meet their needs.
Maintain the integrity of the data in the CRM with updated contact and account information
Demonstrate strategic business awareness of the market to differentiate Discovery brand from the competition.
Attend conferences, trade shows, and seminars as required.
Respect the privacy of the personal information of patients, co-workers, and all individuals with whom the Company interacts.

Compensation and Benefits:

Discovery Life Sciences is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, and we strive to provide employees with total compensation packages that are market competitive. For this role, the anticipated total compensation range is $200,000-$240,000 (base + commission at 100% of target). The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.

Your annual salary is only one part of your total compensation package. Other benefits:

Competitive salary and benefits package options, including a free dental, vision package, life insurance, and disability coverage which start on your first day of employment.
401(k) match program which starts on your first day of employment.
Time away from work (Generous vacation and paid time off, paid parental leave, paid family leave, etc.).
Professional development opportunities and reimbursement for relevant certifications and tuition.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment that values diversity.
Team-building activities and social events.
Employee Referral Program and Colleague Recognition Program.

Location:

Remote – must live near assigned territory (greater Boston, MA area)
Up to 50% travel domestic.

We are actively seeking motivated, dedicated individuals like you to join our thriving organization. As a leader in our industry, we offer unparalleled opportunities for professional growth and success.

to join our team!

jobs.title: Regional Director of Operations
jobs.description:
Regional Director of Operations

The Regional Director of Operations will report directly to the Regional Vice President and will oversee several branches across the region. While the role provides broader regional oversight, as the company continues to strengthen and expand its presence in this market, this position will drive operational performance, customer retention, financial improvement, leadership accountability, and regional growth while ensuring branch priorities are consistently executed.

Why This Role

This is an ideal opportunity for an operations leader who wants to take the next step in their career and have a visible impact on a growing region. The Regional Director of Operations will have direct exposure to regional leadership and will play a vital role in improving operations, strengthening client relationships, developing branch leaders, and driving growth throughout the region. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful regional priorities, solve complex operational challenges, and directly influence the performance and direction of the business. Successful performance in this position can create opportunities for increased responsibility and advancement within the company. For a motivated leader who wants to grow beyond managing individual accounts or a single branch, this role provides the experience, visibility, and responsibility needed to advance their career.

Operational Focus

Maintain a consistent focus on customer retention by identifying account risks, addressing service concerns, and developing strategies to strengthen client relationships.
Review upcoming client rate increases and coordinate with operational and financial teams to ensure increases are implemented accurately and on schedule.
Review branch financial performance, including revenue, gross profit, labor performance, and budget variances, and develop corrective action plans where needed.
Audit payroll and invoice adjustments, identify recurring issues, and implement corrective measures to improve accuracy and reduce adjustments.
Audit regional vehicle inventory and related billing data to ensure accurate records, appropriate utilization, and proper client billing.
Audit overtime, unfilled shifts, and other labor hours, and develop strategies to reduce unnecessary labor costs and improve scheduling efficiency.
Analyze employee turnover trends and implement strategies to improve retention and reduce turnover.
Review regional equipment, uniform, technology, and supply usage to reduce unnecessary costs and ensure client requirements are met.
Oversee new account launches, major expansions, and client transitions to ensure staffing, training, equipment, and operational requirements are completed before implementation.
Provide regular updates and reports on branch leaders, including individual performance, progress against expectations, areas of improvement, and ongoing development needs.

Sales and Growth

Establish regional growth targets and regularly report progress, risks, and forecasted results to the Regional Vice President.
Track the regional sales pipeline, including lead status, proposal activity, expected revenue, and next steps, and hold branch leaders accountable for follow-up.
Submit weekly sales leads, audit lead-generation activity across the region, report on progress, and develop improvement plans where performance is below expectations.
Identify new business opportunities, target markets, and prospective clients that support regional growth objectives.
Identify opportunities to expand services, locations, hours, or solutions with existing clients.
Review lost opportunities and unsuccessful proposals to identify trends and improve future sales strategies.

Experience

Bachelor's degree in business or related field
3-5 years prior Branch Manager, Regional Manager, or similar
Certification is relevant fields a plus

Physical Requirements

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk
Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times

Compensation

$105,000.00 - $115,000.00 per year
Sales Commission Plan
Annual Discretionary Bonus
Other - Fuel Card

Benefits

Paid time off
Health insurance
Dental insurance
Vision insurance

Location: IL - Oak Brook
